findings.what: Confirmation email sent after commit without error handling; a mail-transport failure returns an error to the patient although the appointment is booked, and a retry hits SLOT_TAKEN on their own booking
Staff views skip the §8.1 Schedule-X resource view and TanStack data table in favor of a custom grid; reception board is day-only and doctor week view is 5 days only
Rate limit keyed on spoofable x-forwarded-for and held in memory per process
Past/weekday disabling uses browser timezone instead of the clinic timezone (server re-validates)
Strict ±5 min window on reminder_at means a missed cron window permanently skips that reminder (no catch-up)
A new patient row is created on every booking with no dedup by email
